title: Reports from the Board of Police Commissioners (BPC) and the City Attorney and revised draft Ordinance relative to amending Los Angeles Municipal Code…
text:
[Council File 23-0529]
Reports from the Board of Police Commissioners (BPC) and the City Attorney and revised draft Ordinance relative to amending Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC) Section 80.73.1 of Division N, Chapter VIII to include Recreational Vehicles as vehicles that an operator is prohibited from renting, leasing, or selling in the public right- of-way and amending the LAMC to update the fines and late penalties for all violations of LAMC Section 80.73.1. [This item is referred to the Transportation Committee, Public Works Committee, and Homelessness and Health Committee. On February 25, 2026, the Transportation Committee noted and filed the BPC and City Attorney reports, approved the revised draft Ordinance, and approved the matter as amended by Motion (Hernandez - Hutt).]
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Homelessness and Health Committee action: Continued (Nov 10, 2026)
